about: Where the people of a generated settlement work whose work has no place of its own built for it (src/world/community/commons.ts): by the water, in the fields, or in the lanes behind the heart; whoever works in the open of the heart (a carter, a tinker, a reeve) works there. The owner's review of Mission 18 found a green at eight in the morning with a thatcher, a weaver and a farmer standing on it. {place} is the settlement's name.

waterside.name: the waterside at {place}
waterside.scene: Boats drawn up on the bank, nets drying on poles, a plank jetty, and the water going by. Whoever works the water works here, and talks to it.

fields.name: the home fields of {place}
fields.scene: Strips of field run out from the houses to the hedges, with a trodden track between them and somebody bent over in most of them. A dog watches the track for them.

lanes.name: the lanes behind {place}
lanes.scene: Behind the heart the lanes run between yards and workshops: the sound of a hammer, a smell of bread or tallow, a door open on somebody's work, a cat asleep on a sill.
